name: Cheryl's Bahamas Taxi and Tours
brand_truth: Cheryl's driver is the one in navy and yellow holding your name at Nassau arrivals, for over 25 years.
buyer: US resort guests and cruise passengers, families and Spanish-speaking visitors booking transfers and private tours on phones.

design.signature: Live arrivals name card the visitor types into (their real meet-and-greet), plus a tour planner from their real stops that emails the plan; filterable tour catalogue

current_site_findings: Covid-19 banner still at the top
Five phone numbers and a live.com email
Old viewport zooms out on phones; tours are one long list
pitch_line: Your best promise is a driver holding the guest's name at arrivals; this concept lets them see their own name on your sign before they land, then book the pickup in one go.
assumptions: Tour descriptions condensed from their own tour page; historical claims about the Cloisters and Bat Cave left out
Brand colours taken from their navy and yellow uniform
notes: Live but dated site (2022 footer, Covid banner). Contacts from their own site: office 242-423-4982 / 242-393-9899, out of hours 242-525-5729, email cherylfoxferguson@live.com (suggest a branded domain email at launch). No WhatsApp found, so planners email or call. Photos hotlinked from their /Resources/. interact.mjs dead input is the number field.
